_note: Mark: maker; Economy (rebuild-heroes.md, section 8f, path 3; phase 8 part 6, 8f-5). Enabler. The Bounty is its own Mark (statuses.json's bounty), on the toughest enemy (toughest_enemies), passed to the next toughest without one. The feat deed: one Bounty killed by the heroes' side. Tuned by build (8f-5b): the transformed Bounty's Mark is +40% (strength_add_bp 2500), and the stage has +20% ATK and max HP: floor +10, lift +18 (from +0 and +6 at the design's numbers).
